inputs.paths: one or more files or directories

compatibility.custom_options: unknown long options are forwarded to the transform as values; repeated options preserve all values
compatibility.writes: a file is written only when a transform returns successfully; a transform error does not partially write its source
compatibility.parallelism: worker scheduling does not change per-file results or aggregate status counts
compatibility.encoding: UTF-8 source text and non-ASCII characters are preserved when a transform makes no semantic change
compatibility.ast_collections: transforms can traverse collections and use standard jscodeshift builders before printing
compatibility.ast_formatting: comments and source formatting remain stable when an AST transform changes a node
compatibility.ast_syntax: TypeScript, TSX, and modern JavaScript syntax remain available to AST transforms

errors: diagnostic on stderr and non-zero exit status when requested by the CLI contract
